subject: Invoice channel strategy & go‑live checklist
messages:
From: AP Team <ap_team@greendale.software>

Cc: vendor-invoice@greendale.software
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice delivery preferences and requirements

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier — Greendale is ready to move Redwood live on Sep 15. Before we flip the switch we need to confirm invoice delivery and formatting so AP can automate receipt and matching. Attached is our standard AP requirements doc with preferred fields (PO, remittance address, line-item SKU codes).

Questions:
- Can you send consolidated monthly PDF invoices to billing@greendale.software?
- Do you support e-invoice XML (UBL) or an SFTP drop?
- We also need the billing contact on each invoice and a VAT/tax identifier field visible on the PDF.

If you can confirm channel and a short go‑live checklist by EOD tomorrow, we can ensure payments start in the first cycle.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
AP Manager, Greendale Software
attachments: greendale-ap-invoice-requirements.docx (docx)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: AP Team <ap_team@greendale.software>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-08T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preferences and requirements

Elena — thanks for the clear doc. Quick summary of options and recommended path from Redwood: 

1) Portal (preferred for scale)
   - Full-featured: monthly consolidated PDFs, invoice history, per-invoice metadata (PO, tax id, billing contact).
   - Supports SFTP ingestion for partners and automated webhook notifications once invoices are posted.
   - Best long-term for reconciliation if you plan to integrate into an AP system.

2) Email copies (fastest short-term)
   - We can send consolidated monthly PDF to billing@greendale.software and cc vendor-invoice@greendale.so.
   - Good if you need a manual review step before adding to your ERP.

3) E-invoice (XML/UBL)
   - We have limited e-invoice XML support via our dedicated billing integration (requires mapping review). Could be available in ~4 weeks.

For Sep 15 go‑live I recommend starting with monthly consolidated PDFs to billing@greendale.so so there’s no blocker; we can enable portal access for your AP team within 5 business days after go‑live. If you want us to start with SFTP or XML now, we’ll need the field mapping questionnaire filled out (I can share).

Next steps I will take:
- Marissa will draft the invoice sample we will send for your PO/field verification.
- Laura will set up the temporary email routing and add billing@greendale.software to our delivery list.

Can you confirm billing@greendale.software is the final delivery address and provide the AP contact name + PO (if applicable)?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
From: AP Team <ap_team@greendale.software>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>

Hi Vivek — thanks.

Confirming: please send consolidated monthly PDFs to billing@greendale.software for now. We will onboard to your portal within two weeks.

AP contact: Elena Morales (elena@greendale.software), billing@greendale.software is monitored by AP.
PO: For the initial month please reference PO# GDS-2027-0915-01 on the invoice.
VAT/Tax: Greendale VAT ID is GB999888777. We need VAT ID visible on the invoice PDF.

We do have a preference for an XML option down the road — happy to kick off mapping once the portal is available.

Elena

Go‑live checklist (Sep 15):
- [x] Temporary delivery: consolidated monthly PDF -> billing@greendale.software (Marissa configured routing).
- [x] Add PO reference field so AP can auto-match (we will include PO# GDS-2027-0915-01).
- [x] Include Billing contact on each invoice (Elena Morales).
- [x] VAT ID printed on invoice header (GB999888777).
- [ ] Portal invite: create AP admin user after first invoice cycle (target: Sep 22).
- [ ] XML/SFTP mapping: schedule mapping call if you want e-invoice automation (target: early Oct).

Attachment: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (PDF, contains example header, line items, GST/VAT field).

If everything looks good I’ll send the first PDF on Sep 15 and follow up with portal invite instructions. Also attaching an AP authorization form in case you need it completed for SFTP access — feel free to return signed to operations@redwood.ai.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
